# NimBox SRE

> NimBox SRE is a managed site reliability engineering and observability service for operating infrastructure, including hosts behind NAT, with the same technical team.

## Overview

NimBox SRE combines host monitoring, incident management, a self-discovering agent, privileged access management (PAM), eBPF profiling, operational integrations, and monthly service reports. It is designed to complement existing monitoring rather than replace it.

## Key capabilities

- Unified host context: status, metrics, processes, and incident history.
- Coordinated incident response with ownership, severity, evidence, and SLAs.
- Single-file agent with automatic discovery of services, processes, and containers; works behind NAT without exposing SSH.
- On-demand eBPF profiling for I/O latency and kernel-stack investigation.
- Native PAM registration and audited SSH access without sending passwords in transit.
- Monthly operational evidence and SLA reporting.
- Integration with existing alerts, error tracking, and operational tooling.

## Who it is for

Teams that already monitor their infrastructure but need to resolve more incidents, operate hard-to-reach hosts, preserve operational knowledge, and demonstrate delivered service without building a 24/7 NOC.
